_meta.note: The three Iberian Pyrite Belt communities Strata is working with through the FIERCE Ideation project. Each has a legacy mining landscape beside it and faces a live decision about what happens to it next. Resident voices below are placeholders that the FIERCE service S2 social needs research will replace with anonymised themes and preferences in 2027.
_meta.research_provider: FIERCE Ideation service S2 (to be contracted)
_meta.sample_target: 18 semi-structured interviews across the three communities plus one community session per community (30+ participants in total)

communities.name: Mina de São Domingos
communities.landscape_character: Red-tinted waste heaps around a flooded open pit, a well-preserved mining village and a tourism trail along the Chança valley. Mining ended in 1966.
communities.livelihoods_today: Rural depopulation; tourism (mining heritage, Guadiana valley); small-scale agriculture.
main_concerns_prelim: Dust from heaps in the dry summer, especially where any reprocessing would happen
Water quality in the Chança and the streams flowing off the heaps
Preserving the mining village as a heritage asset, including miners' housing
Whether reopening or reprocessing would bring work back, and for whom

pathway_preferences_prelim.leave_and_monitor: Preferred by heritage voices and most residents interviewed in the first scoping call
pathway_preferences_prelim.rehabilitate: Supported if it protects water downstream without erasing the mining landscape
pathway_preferences_prelim.reprocess_and_rehabilitate: Mixed; interest in jobs, concern about dust and water

communities.contact_point: Câmara Municipal de Mértola (preliminary conversation held 2026-09)

communities.name: Minas de Riotinto and Nerva
communities.municipality: Minas de Riotinto and Nerva, Huelva, Spain
communities.landscape_character: The Río Tinto district, operating mine (Atalaya Mining) inside a large historic district; the Río Tinto itself is a global reference for naturally acid water. Multiple generations of mining families; the heritage museum and tourist train on the former Riotinto railway.
communities.livelihoods_today: The reopened Riotinto copper mine (Atalaya) is the largest employer. Mining heritage tourism. Agricultural and service work in surrounding villages.
main_concerns_prelim: Air quality and noise around the active pit and the processing plant
How the operating mine and the historic district should coexist, including the heritage train and museum
Water quality in the Tinto, now that extraction is active again
Whether satellite monitoring could be used to hold the operator to account, independently of regional authorities

pathway_preferences_prelim.leave_and_monitor: Not applicable at the operating site; preferred for the historic peripheral waste
pathway_preferences_prelim.rehabilitate: Priority for the peripheral heaps; sensitive to heritage
pathway_preferences_prelim.reprocess_and_rehabilitate: Mixed; opinions polarise between those who work at Atalaya and those who do not

communities.name: Aznalcóllar
communities.landscape_character: Site of the 1998 tailings dam failure, one of the worst mining environmental events in European history. Regional approval granted in 2025 to reopen as Minera Los Frailes (Grupo México); production planned from 2028; the planned discharge to the Guadalquivir estuary is contested.
communities.livelihoods_today: A town built on and divided by mining. Agriculture downstream; proximity to the Doñana National Park.
main_concerns_prelim: What a second tailings management plan looks like, 30 years after the first failed
The planned discharge to the estuary and its downstream effects on Doñana
Whether local hires will match the jobs the previous operator promised
How change on the ground, from preparation through production, is monitored independently

pathway_preferences_prelim.leave_and_monitor: Not applicable; the decision to reopen has been taken at regional level
pathway_preferences_prelim.rehabilitate: Previous rehabilitation after 1998 is a key reference; residents want to see what remains and what is being replaced
pathway_preferences_prelim.reprocess_and_rehabilitate: The core live question; opinions sharply divided

communities.contact_point: Local environmental groups (confidential; initial contact 2026-10). The FIERCE S2 provider will use neutral facilitation and separate sessions on request.
